acceptance_contract.appearance_value: challenger NCC minus maximum selected-conflict NCC

legacy_geometry_gate_recorded_but_not_ex.reason: The learned r10 sparse-feature gate has no defined feature representation for out-of-pool r10--12 candidates. The deterministic motion gate is the shell geometry prefilter; fabricating r10 scorer features would violate fail-closed reuse.

acceptance_contract.node_disjoint_ordering: appearance_swap._greedy_nonconflicting: descending margin, then challenger identity
acceptance_contract.unlabeled_semantics: sampled deployment background is unknown, but is counted as adverse for conservative fast-fail precision and utility

decision.rationale: failed fit_precision_at_least_0p95, both_family_precision_and_utility, positive_capped_utility, bounded_added_background, projected_oracle_margin

bounded_added_background.justification: At most one sampled-unlabeled accepted proposal per fixed fit-validation video.

motion_model.justification: Constant velocity is causal, parameter-free, already encoded by the selected-graph history features, and adds no learned weights.
motion_model.name: selected-track constant velocity
motion_model.prediction: source position minus its adjacent selected-graph predecessor position, in physical micrometres
